items.title: 70980_Quinn Wilson oral history interview
items.q: Where Nat King Cole got started.

ctx.x: Chicago? Well, I sat in on a few of them. I can't remember. All I can remember is you used to go around to after hours spots and hang out. And sometimes you'd have a jam session when the guys would get off. They'd come by there and the Panama on 58th Street was one of them. Where Nat King Cole got started.
The Three Deuces downtown was well known.
